quickStatus_subServer.message: Who can access your private servers

settings_avatarSearch_desc.message: Add a search bar to the avatar editor to quickly find items by name.

settings_avatarSearch_filtersDesc.message: Adds filters to the avatar search bar: creator name, price range, availability, effects, and limiteds.

settings_bloatwareRemover_badgesDesc.message: Hides the "Popular" badges Roblox shows on some games and items.

settings_bloatwareRemover_desc.message: Removes unnecessary UI elements, sponsored content, and promotional features from Roblox pages.

settings_bloatwareRemover_faqDesc.message: Hides the FAQ card that Roblox injects into some pages.

settings_bloatwareRemover_footerDesc.message: Hides promotional and non-essential links in the Roblox page footer.

settings_bloatwareRemover_navigationDesc.message: Hides promo entries in the Roblox navigation bar, such as Blog, Official Store, and Gift Cards.

settings_bloatwareRemover_phoneUpsellDes.message: Removes the phone number upsell cards on the home page.

settings_bloatwareRemover_plusAdsDesc.message: Hides Roblox Plus advertising, such as the sidebar Plus link and note, the Buy Robux Plus upsell, and the Plus subscribe banner.

settings_bloatwareRemover_plusAssetsDesc.message: Hides the Roblox Plus icon artwork shown on server lists and elsewhere on the site.

settings_bloatwareRemover_premiumDesc.message: Hides Premium subscription buttons and upgrade prompts.

settings_bloatwareRemover_sponsoredDesc.message: Hides sponsored games, promoted cards, and advertisement slots.

settings_botDetector_desc.message: Analyzes game servers to detect potential bot activity.

settings_botDetector_roundWholeDesc.message: Round bot percentage to nearest whole number (e.g., '43%' instead of '42.9%')

settings_botDetector_showDatabaseDesc.message: Display a button to view all player thumbnails analyzed during detection

settings_bundleItemViewer_desc.message: On item pages of items inside of a bundle, shows what bundle the item is from.

settings_chatEligibility_desc.message: Shows if you can chat with a friend or haven't done an age check when hovering over the chat button on their profile. Inspired by RoValra's Chat Eligibility Tooltip feature.

settings_friendOrigin_desc.message: Shows where and when you became friends with a user on the friends list.

settings_bulkUnfriend_desc.message: Allows you to bulk unfriend users from the friends list.

settings_bestFriends_homeStar_desc.message: Shows the star button on friends in the home page carousel. Turn it off to keep best friends pinned without the star there.

settings_bestFriends_desc.message: Star a friend on their card to keep them at the front of your friends list and the home carousel, whatever their status.

settings_mostPlayedTogether_desc.message: Shows which games you and your friends have played together the most.

settings_credit_cjiggy.message: Super important tester who helped make sure everything functioned in the early days of Purpura. He was there since day one, and I am incredibly grateful.

settings_credit_deluxis.message: Another notable tester who made very detailed bug reports and helped crack down on any critical bugs.

settings_credit_valra.message: Huge inspiration during Purpura's development and helped with a lot of the startup support for region-related code.

settings_credits_footer.message: Thank you to everyone who contributed to this project. Join our Discord server to share feedback, report bugs, and stay up to date.

settings_credits_subtitle.message: Special thanks to everyone who supported Purpura.

settings_info_about.message: Purpura is a feature-rich Roblox enhancement suite that aims to be your all-in-one extension.

settings_info_navigate.message: Use the sidebar on the left to move between settings.

settings_info_backupDesc.message: Export your settings to a file, restore them on another device, or start over from the defaults.

settings_friendsManager_desc.message: Adds a button to the friends page to manage friends in bulk (unfriend/block).

settings_playtime_desc.message: Tracks how long you spend in Roblox games, even when the tab is closed.

settings_playtime_import_desc.message: Bring your RoPro playtime history into Purpura before you disable RoPro.

settings_playtime_import_btnTitle.message: Import your playtime history from RoPro

settings_playtime_import_step1Desc.message: Go to chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, find RoPro and click Service Worker.

settings_playtime_import_step2Desc.message: Paste the script below into the console and press Enter. If prompted, type allow pasting first.

settings_playtime_import_step3Desc.message: Right-click the printed array, pick Copy object, then paste it below and press Import.

settings_playtime_import_gist.message: (or get the script from the Gist Repository)

settings_playtime_import_errInvalidJson.message: Invalid JSON. Make sure you copied the entire output.

settings_playtime_import_errNotArray.message: Invalid data format. Expected an array of games.

settings_playtime_import_errNoGames.message: No games found in the data.

settings_playtime_import_errMissingField.message: Entry at position $1 is missing required fields.

settings_playtime_import_errBadTime.message: Entry at position $1 has an invalid time_played value.

settings_playtime_import_errBadId.message: Entry at position $1 has an invalid id.

settings_playtime_import_errNoPlaytime.message: No games with playtime were found in the data.

settings_playtime_import_toast.message: Imported $1 games ($2) from RoPro into your tracker.

settings_gameLauncherWidget_desc.message: A floating search widget to launch any game instantly from any Roblox page.

settings_gameOutfits_desc1.message: View and equip your saved outfits directly from game pages.

settings_gameOutfits_desc2.message: Adds an 'Outfits' tab to the game navigation bar.

settings_shareServerLinks_desc.message: Adds Copy Link to public server cards. Short links expire after 30 days; a full link is used if the API is unavailable. Recipients do not need Purpura. Links do not bypass full servers or privacy restrictions.

settings_playerFinder_desc.message: Adds a search bar to a game's server list that finds which server a player is in and lets you join it. Uses Roblox presence and public server data; players whose joins are hidden, and games that hide their player lists, cannot be found.

playerFinder_placeholder.message: Find a player in this game…

playerFinder_presenceLine.message: Playing in this game right now

playerFinder_notFound.message: Scanned {servers} servers and {players} players. {name} was not found. Roblox only shows a sample of players per server.

playerFinder_noTokens.message: Roblox isn't listing players for this game's servers, so a search can't run right now.

playerFinder_noUser.message: No Roblox user found with that name.

playerFinder_error.message: Couldn't search right now. Try again in a moment.

settings_recentServers_desc.message: Remembers the servers you play in and lists them above a game's server list so you can rejoin them. Servers that have since shut down can no longer be joined.

shareServer_missing.message: Server ID is not available yet. Try again.

shareServer_fallback.message: Using a full link because short links are unavailable.

shareServer_expiry.message: Short links expire after 30 days. Servers can close sooner.

settings_gameReviews_desc.message: Read community ratings and publish reviews with an unverified Roblox username. Reviews are public; profanity is filtered. Turning this off stops review API requests.

settings_shopOffers_desc.message: Shows the active Roblox shop offers above the game passes on a game's store tab, so you can see which in-game purchases are discounted without joining the experience.

shopOffers_inGameOnly.message: Only applies to purchases made in-game.

settings_outboundProtection_desc.message: Automatically cancels outbound trades at or above your loss threshold using Rolimon’s values (RAP for unvalued items) and Robux after the receiving fee. Opt-in; checks up to 10 newest trades every 30 seconds while Chrome runs. Missing or stale data stops cancellation. This is not guaranteed account protection. Values: Rolimon’s (rolimons.com).

settings_outboundProtection_thresholdDes.message: Loss percentage, greater than 0 and at most 100 (default 50). Invalid input disables cancellation. Cancelled offers cannot be restored automatically.

settings_privateServerControls_desc.message: Adds link and friends controls to the private servers you own.

settings_privateServerControls_quickLink.message: Quick Private Server Link Copy and Generation
Adds copy and regenerate link buttons to your private servers.

settings_privateServerControls_friendsTo.message: Adds a Friends Allowed switch to your private servers.

settings_privateServerControls_autoAllow.message: Friends Allowed On New Private Servers
Turns the switch on for every new private server.

settings_projectedWarnings_desc.message: Shows an attributed warning on catalog items flagged as projected by Rolimon’s. Inflated RAP is not a reliable trading value. Unknown items show no warning, not a safety guarantee.

projected_unavailable.message: Projected-item check unavailable. This item has not been checked; do not assume it is safe.

projected_warning.message: Projected item: its RAP may be inflated. Verify its value before trading

settings_liveCounters_desc.message: Refreshes players, visits, likes, dislikes, and favorites every 15 seconds while the page is visible. Roblox may update its totals in batches.

settings_liveCounters_likeDislikeDesc.message: Updates likes, dislikes, and favorites on game pages with the latest Roblox counts.

settings_liveCounters_playersDesc.message: Updates the active-player count on game pages with live data.

settings_liveCounters_visitsDesc.message: Updates the total-visits count on game pages with live data.

settings_gameOutfits_launchPopup.message: Show outfit selector on game launch

settings_gameOutfits_launchPopupDesc.message: Display a popup to change outfit when clicking Play

settings_ghostProfiles_desc.message: Allows you to view banned users profiles.

settings_ghostProfiles_webRequestDesc.message: Required to detect redirected banned user profiles.

settings_greetings_desc.message: Display unique greetings with various rarities when visiting Roblox.

settings_hideDownloadButton_desc.message: Hides the Download button from the Roblox navigation bar.

settings_freeRobloxPlusThemes_desc.message: Allows you to use Roblox Plus themes on the site without Roblox Plus.

frpt_notice.message: Select and use any theme without Roblox Plus.

settings_homePageTweaks_desc.message: Allows you to rearrange and customize the Roblox Home Page by hiding or showing specific sections, and rearranging the order of visible sections.

settings_homePageTweaks_homePageButtonDe.message: Adds a button to the Roblox Home page, allowing you to quickly edit it.

settings_betterContinue_autoRefresh_desc.message: Updates the Continue row after a game launches, without reloading the page.

settings_avatarCycler_desc.message: Cycle through your saved avatars automatically on a customizable interval.

settings_infiniteAvatar_desc.message: Equip up to 10 accessories and up to 10 layered clothing items while customizing your avatar.

settings_itemExplorer_desc.message: Adds an item page explorer for quickly previewing and downloading available item assets.

settings_lastOnline_desc.message: Records when users were last online, only works if they were online once after this was enabled.

settings_noRent_desc.message: Hides all rent options on the catalog.

settings_pageBinds_desc1.message: Create custom keyboard shortcuts to quickly navigate between Roblox pages.

settings_pageBinds_desc2.message: Press the key while on any Roblox page to navigate to the bound URL.

settings_pill_beta_tooltip.message: This feature is in beta, and it may be unstable and cause issues. Use with caution.

settings_pill_experimental_tooltip.message: This feature is experimental and may break at any time. Use with caution.

settings_pill_deprecated_tooltip.message: This feature is deprecated and no longer maintained. It has been disabled.

settings_pinnedGames_desc.message: Bookmark and organize your favorite games for quick access from any Roblox page.

settings_purpuraCursors_desc.message: Customize your cursor with various styles while browsing Roblox. Select a preset below or upload a custom image.

settings_purpuraCursors_trailEffectsDesc.message: Show animated particle effects that follow your cursor movement

settings_purpuraTabs_desc1.message: Customize the browser tab appearance when on Roblox pages.

settings_purpuraTabs_desc2.message: Change the tab title format and favicon icon.

settings_purpurasSelection_desc.message: Adds a curated 'Purpura's Selection' game carousel to the Charts page showcasing hand-picked hidden gems across various genres.

settings_quickPlay_desc.message: Show a play button overlay on game cards on the home page for instant game launching.

settings_quickStatusSwitcher_desc.message: Adds a button to the navbar to quickly change your online status, join settings, privacy options and theme on the fly.

settings_quickStatusSwitcher_themeIntegr.message: Adds your custom themes and Purpura prepackaged themes to the Quick Settings theme setting list. Does nothing without the Theme Editor feature being enabled.

settings_redesignedAvatarEditor_desc.message: Completely redesigns the Roblox Avatar Editor.

settings_remainingRobux_desc.message: Adds back the feature that Roblox removed, displaying your remaining Robux Balance in the purchase confirmation dialog.

settings_purpuraSidebar_desc.message: Replaces Roblox's sidebar with Purpura's own modern and clean sidebar.

settings_sidebarTweaks_desc.message: Adds various enhancements and tweaks to the Roblox sidebar.

settings_sidebarTweaks_hoverExpand_desc.message: Collapses the Roblox sidebar, and expands when hovered.

settings_sidebarTweaks_layout_desc.message: Adds a button to the sidebar that lets you rearrange and toggle items on the sidebar.

sidebarTweaks_overlayHint.message: Drag to reorder. Use the eye to show or hide an item.

sidebarTweaks_empty.message: Purpura could not find any sidebar buttons.

settings_roThemer_desc1.message: Customize Roblox's theme with advanced color schemes and styling options.

settings_roThemer_desc2.message: Select a theme below to apply it site-wide.

settings_robloxAgeTheme_desc.message: Switch between different Roblox age theme styles.

settings_robloxAgeTheme_themeDesc.message: Choose which Roblox age theme to apply.

settings_robuxConversations_desc.message: Converts Robux amounts across the site to your chosen currency, with a selectable rate type and color.

settings_robuxConversations_rateTypeDesc.message: Which Robux rate the conversion uses.

settings_robuxConversations_currencyDesc.message: The currency amounts are converted to.

settings_robuxConversations_customRateDe.message: US dollars per Robux, used when the rate type is Custom. For example 0.0125.

settings_robuxBalancePrecision_desc.message: How many digits the top bar shows for a large Robux balance, such as 1.23M instead of 1M+.

settings_robuxBonusItem_desc.message: When buying Robux, lets you pick which free bonus item or game pass you receive instead of the default one.

settings_saveLotsRobux_desc1.message: Save 10-60% Robux on any purchase on the Roblox website.

settings_saveLotsRobux_desc2.message: Catalog and bundle purchases estimate 40% savings, and game pass purchases estimate 10% savings.

settings_saveLotsRobux_placeIdDesc.message: Place ID used when launching an experience for the Robux Saver purchase flow.

slr_setup_warning_text.message: The group owner cannot be the same account you are buying items with. Use a secured alt account with 2FA enabled and a strong, unique password.

slr_setup_step1.message: Create a group on your alt account.

slr_setup_step2.message: In Roblox Studio (logged into the alt), create a new Baseplate.

slr_setup_step3.message: Insert a Script in ServerScriptService named PurpuraPurchaseHandler.

slr_setup_step4.message: Paste the Lua code below into that script.

slr_setup_step5.message: In Game Settings > Monetization, enable Third-Party Sales.

slr_setup_step6.message: Publish to Roblox under your group.

slr_setup_step7.message: Copy the Place ID from the URL and enter it in the settings for Robux Saver.

slr_setup_payouts_text.message: Only the group owner account can pay out saved Robux.

slr_setup_pending_text.message: Funds are pending for approximately one month before payout.

settings_crowdServers_desc.message: Shares the server regions you resolve with other Purpura users, so even full servers Roblox will not report on can show a region. Fully anonymous: no account, and no personal data is ever sent.

settings_crowdServers_recommended.message: Highly recommended to keep enabled. The more people who share, the more accurate server regions become for everyone, and you can turn it off at any time.

settings_serverInfo_desc.message: Shows game server information such as ping, region, and FPS on game pages.

settings_siteFixes_desc.message: Fixes various issues and poor design choices with the Roblox website.

settings_usernameColorPreview_desc.message: Changes the username color on a user's profile to what Roblox would give them in the Roblox in-game chat.

settings_thumbnailBackgroundDisabler_des.message: Prevents profile backgrounds from appearing in avatar headshots and other areas.

settings_avatarImageDownloader_desc.message: Adds a button on users profiles to save their avatar as a PNG file.

avatarDownloader_failed.message: Failed to download avatar. Try again later.

settings_siteFont_desc.message: Replaces the Roblox website font with any font from Google Fonts.

settings_siteFont_fontUrlDesc.message: Paste a link from fonts.google.com (for example https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Comic+Neue), a Google Fonts stylesheet URL, or just the font name.

settings_statusSpoofer_desc.message: Spoof your online status to either appear offline or show as being in Studio.

settings_statusSpoofer_note.message: **Note:** It can take up to 5 minutes to update, and you must keep the tab open for as long as you want the spoof to persist.

settings_streamerMode_desc.message: Hide your name, Robux, account details and online status. Choose a preset or fine-tune each item below.

settings_blurSerialNumbers_desc.message: Hide limited item serial numbers on trade pages.

settings_disableVideoAutoplay_desc.message: Stops videos from autoplaying on the Roblox website.

settings_tabs_titleHint.message: Use {title} for the page title, {n} for notifications icon. Example: "{title} ⋅ Purpura {n}"

settings_theme_pasteHint.message: Paste your theme CSS below. Include a manifest comment at the top:

settings_trustedCreatorStatus_desc.message: Shows whether Roblox identifies your account as a member of the Trusted Creator Program in your account settings.

settings_uncorporatify_desc.message: Restore the classic Roblox look by renaming corporate terms to user-friendly names.

settings_unpendingRobux_desc1.message: Shows an estimate of how many pending Robux will stop pending within 24 hours.

settings_unpendingRobux_desc2.message: May be inaccurate and can take longer on accounts with large transaction history.

settings_unpendingRobux_showPendingDesc.message: Replaces your Robux balance and its conversions with your pending Robux when you hover over the Robux amount in the navbar.

settings_totalSpent_desc.message: Adds a "lifetime transactions" section to the transaction page showing you how much Robux you have spent and earned across your account's transaction history Also calculates net gained/lost.

tcs_tooltip.message: Whether Roblox treats this account as part of the Trusted Creator Program. This comes straight from Roblox and may not be accurate.

tse_rateLimited.message: Rate limited by Roblox - resuming in $SECONDS$s...

tse_rateLimitedError.message: Roblox is rate limiting this scan. Try again in a few minutes.

store_supportDesc.message: Your support funds development and keeps features free for everyone. Select an amount below.

unpending_insufficientTooltip.message: Not enough transaction history to make an accurate estimate. Please wait for more transactions to complete.

unpending_pendingTooltip.message: Robux you have earned but that has not been released to your balance yet.

unpending_tooltip.message: This is an estimate of how many Robux from your pending balance will become available tomorrow, based on your transaction data. The actual amount may vary and may be inaccurate.

settings_r6WarningRemover_desc.message: Removes the R6 Warning banner when switching from R15 to R6.

settings_verifiedBadge_desc.message: Shows the verified checkmark next to your own name across Roblox. Only you can see it.

settings_robloxWrapped_desc.message: A year-in-review of your Robux spending, with your top experiences, creators and biggest purchases, plus an image to share. Everything stays in your browser.

settings_robloxWrapped_nye_desc.message: On December 31, shows your Wrapped image for the year the first time you open Roblox.

settings_gameBlocker_desc.message: Hide experiences you never want to see from Home, Charts, search and recommendations. Block single experiences, everything by a creator, or anything whose name matches a keyword.

settings_gameBlocker_cardButton_desc.message: Shows a block button when you hover over a game card.

settings_gameBlocker_pageButton_desc.message: Adds a Block button next to Favorite on game pages, with an option to block the creator.

settings_mostPlayed_desc.message: Shows a compact panel of your most played games in the top right of the home page, ranked by time played over the past 7 days, 30 days or all time. Requires Play Time Tracker.

mostPlayed_emptyRange.message: No playtime recorded in this period yet.

mostPlayed_empty.message: Play a game and it will show up here. Purpura tracks your playtime while Roblox runs.

settings_offsaleLegacyPrices_desc.message: Shows the last-sale price of an offsale item.

settings_enhancedSearch_desc.message: Press '/' to focus the search box and get autocomplete results for users, friends and experiences directly in the dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_userSearchDesc.message: Shows an exact matching user in the search dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_gameSearchDesc.message: Shows the best matching experience in the search dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_friendSearchDesc.message: Shows matching friends in the search dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_focusKeyDesc.message: Press '/' to focus the search box.

settings_customBackdrop_desc.message: Puts an image of your choice behind the Roblox website. Paste an image link or upload your own.

settings_customBackdrop_error.message: Use an https:// image link or upload an image file.

settings_rolimonsProfile_desc.message: Shows a user's total limited RAP and Rolimons value on their profile. Click either one to open their Rolimons page.

settings_extraOutfits_desc.message: Lets you save more characters than Roblox allows. Extra characters are stored on this device and appear alongside your Roblox characters in the avatar editor.

settings_adjustAccessories_desc.message: Adds an Adjust Accessories button to the avatar editor so you can reposition, rotate, scale, and reorder worn accessories.

adjustAccessories_subtitle.message: Reposition, rotate, scale, and reorder worn accessories on your avatar.

adjustAccessories_orderTooltip.message: Controls the composition order for layered clothing. Items with a higher order appear on top.

adjustAccessories_noWornAssets.message: You are not currently wearing any adjustable accessories.

adjustAccessories_fetchError.message: An error occurred while fetching your avatar, please try again later.

adjustAccessories_updateError.message: Failed to update asset, please try again later.

adjustAccessories_removeError.message: Failed to remove worn asset, please try again later.

settings_streamerMode_keybindDesc.message: Click the field and press a combination, for example Ctrl+Shift+M. Press Backspace to clear it.

settings_streamerMode_modalDesc.message: Choose a preset or switch exactly what should be hidden. Every change saves immediately.

settings_streamerMode_preset_everythingD.message: Hides every item below. The most thorough option.

settings_streamerMode_preset_identityDes.message: Hides your name, other players' names, avatars and the games your friends are playing.

settings_streamerMode_preset_accountDesc.message: Hides your email, phone number, birthdate, age, country, login sessions and Robux.

settings_streamerMode_preset_activityDes.message: Hides your online status and the games you and your friends are playing.

settings_streamerMode_item_namesDesc.message: Blurs your username and display name anywhere they appear, including chat buttons.

settings_streamerMode_item_othersDesc.message: Blurs usernames and display names in profile headers, avatar cards and friend lists.

settings_streamerMode_item_avatarsDesc.message: Blurs your avatar and the avatar thumbnails shown around the site.

settings_streamerMode_item_robuxDesc.message: Blurs your Robux balance and the amounts shown in the navbar and menus.

settings_streamerMode_item_gameNamesDesc.message: Blurs the experience names shown on friend tiles.

settings_streamerMode_item_emailDesc.message: Replaces your email, its verification state and your previous usernames in account responses.

settings_streamerMode_item_phoneDesc.message: Replaces the phone number attached to your account in account responses.

settings_streamerMode_item_birthdateDesc.message: Replaces your birth month, day and year in account responses.

settings_streamerMode_item_ageDesc.message: Replaces your verified age and age group in account responses.

settings_streamerMode_item_countryDesc.message: Replaces your account country and region in account responses.

settings_streamerMode_item_sessionsDesc.message: Replaces IP addresses, locations and device details in your login sessions.

settings_streamerMode_item_presenceDesc.message: Hides whether you are online and what you are playing from presence requests.

tour_step_welcome_body.message: Here is a quick look at what Purpura adds to Roblox. Seven stops, about a minute, and you can leave at any point.

tour_step_robux_body.message: Purpura converts your balance into your own currency, keeps the navbar readable at large amounts, and slides your pending Robux into place when you hover the number.

tour_step_search_body.message: Enhanced Search brings users, games and friends into the navbar suggestions and gives you a shortcut straight into the box.

tour_step_sidebar_body.message: Sidebar Tweaks collapses the sidebar until you hover it, lets you rearrange every item, and can replace it with Purpura's own navigation.

tour_step_settings_body.message: This is Purpura Settings: categories down the side, a search box at the top, and every option documented. The tour stops at a few highlights next.

tour_step_appearance_body.message: Theme Editor, fonts, cursors, tab titles and Streamer Mode are all in Appearance. Turn anything on and the site updates as you go.

tour_step_catalog_body.message: Robux Conversions, balance precision, the bonus item picker and price tools are in Catalog. These change what you see on marketplace pages.

tour_outro_body.message: Purpura is free, and it stays free. If it makes Roblox a little better for you, consider supporting development.
